hook.text: One power line sagged into a tree in Ohio in 2003. Within hours, 55 million people across eight states lost electricity.

buildup.text: A cascading failure occurs when one component's failure overloads neighbors, causing them to fail in a chain reaction.

discovery.text: Tightly coupled systems are fastest to cascade.

climax.text: Build circuit breakers: isolation points that stop failure from spreading.

punchline.text: One failure spreading kills the system. Build circuit breakers.

quiz.question: What makes tightly coupled systems vulnerable?
options: One component's failure overloads and triggers failures in connected components
